title: Explicit number fields
summary: Numerically explicit inequalities for a number field K on Mathlib's carriers: explicit ideal counts (Sunley, Lee, Debaene, Gun–Ramaré–Sivaraman), explicit residue bounds for the Dedekind zeta function (Louboutin, Friedman, Stark, Garcia–Lee), class-number, regulator and relative class-number bounds (Louboutin, Bordellès, Cully-Hugill–Trudgian), explicit zero counts and zero-free regions for ζ_K (Trudgian, Hasanalizade–Shen–Wong, Stark, Louboutin, Kadiri, Lee), and explicit bounds on the least primitive root modulo p and p² (McGown–Trudgian, McGown–Treviño–Trudgian, Kerr–McGown–Trudgian).

baseline.mathlib: pinned by lake-manifest.json of the content repository
baseline.tauceti: pinned by lake-manifest.json of the content repository

targets.name: localFactor
targets.statement: localFactor K p = ∏ᶠ (1 − N𝔭⁻¹)⁻¹ (finprod) over the height-one primes 𝔭 containing p, evaluated by every theorem at a prime p (junk value 1 at p = 0, the primes above every prime factor for composite p); localFactorProduct K S = ∏_{p ∈ S} localFactor K p; lambdaS S = ∏_{p ∈ S} (1 + p^{-1/2})^4.
hypotheses: p a natural number (a prime in every API bound)

api.name: localFactor_rat

api.name: localFactor_inert

api.name: localFactor_eq_eulerFactor_one

targets.name: DedekindConjecture
targets.statement: DedekindConjecture K: ∃ entire F with F s · ζ(s) = ζ_K(s) for every s ≠ 1 with ζ(s) ≠ 0; CMPositivity K: ∀ σ ∈ (0,1), 0 ≤ Re L(σ, η); GRHMod q: ∀ χ mod q, DirichletGRH χ; QuadraticRealZeroGap c: every real zero β ∈ (0,1) of ζ_F, F quadratic, has β ≤ 1 − 1/(c√d_F); ImaginaryQuadraticRealZeroGap c: the same for F imaginary quadratic; HasNormalTower K.
hypotheses: K a number field; CMPositivity needs IsCMField K; c > 0

gaps.title: Rademacher's convexity bound on the general record
gaps.detail: For a Layer-0 record of degree m and arithmetic conductor N with Dirichlet agreement, continuation, Λ(s) = εΛ̄(1−s), |ε| = 1, gamma shifts in {0,1}, |a(k)| ≤ τ_m(k), and at most a simple pole at 1: for 0 < η ≤ 1/2, −η ≤ σ ≤ 1+η, ‖L(s)‖ ≤ P(s)(N(|1+s|/(2π))^m)^{(1+η−σ)/2} ζ(1+η)^m, P(s) = 3|(1+s)/(1−s)| with a pole, 1 without. A nonnegative majorant alone fails (10ζ at s = 1/2: 14.60 > 11.49).
gaps.needs: Rademacher's explicit convexity bound for every record of degree m and conductor N with gamma shifts in {0, 1}, coefficients |a(k)| ≤ τ_m(k), root number of modulus 1 and at most a simple pole at 1, with the pole factor 3|(1+s)/(1−s)|

gaps.title: Complex Stirling with constants
gaps.detail: Γ(s) = √(2π) exp((s−1/2) log s − s + ξ_s) with |ξ_s| ≤ 1/(12 sin²(δ/2)|s|) and the two-sided modulus bounds.
gaps.needs: explicit Stirling remainders on sectors and vertical strips

gaps.title: Backlund's argument lemma
gaps.detail: Degree-free: f analytic on a closed disc, ‖f‖ ≤ M‖f(c)‖, the argument variation along a radius is at most π(1 + log M/log(R/r)).
gaps.needs: the explicit argument-count lemma on a disc

gaps.title: Landau's iterated Perron identity
gaps.detail: For F(s) = Σ a_k k^{−s} absolutely convergent on Re s > κ_a, an integer j ≥ 1, c > max(κ_a, 0) and x > 0: (1/2πi)∫_{(c)} F(s) x^{s+j} ds/(s(s+1)⋯(s+j)) converges absolutely and equals (1/j!) Σ_{k≤x} a_k (x − k)^j, the j-fold iterated integral of Σ_{k≤y} a_k.
gaps.needs: the absolutely convergent iterated Perron identity (1/2πi)∫_{(c)} F(s) x^{s+j} ds/(s(s+1)⋯(s+j)) = (1/j!) Σ_{k≤x} a_k (x−k)^j for every integer j ≥ 1, c > max(κ_a, 0) and x > 0

gaps.title: Ramaré's bounds for |L(1, χ)|
gaps.detail: (1/2) log q for even and (1/2) log q + 5/2 − log 6 for odd primitive χ of conductor q.
gaps.needs: the two explicit upper bounds for |L(1, χ)|

gaps.title: Bach's smoothed character sum under GRH
gaps.detail: For χ non-principal mod a prime p with DirichletGRH χ and x ≥ 1, |Σ_{n<x} Λ(n)χ(n)(1 − n/x)| ≤ c(p,x)√x log p with c(p,x) = (2/3)(1 + 2/√x + 3/x^{3/2})(1 + 5/(3 log p)) + (log x + 2)/(√x log p); and |Σ_{n<x} Λ(n)(1 − n/x) − x/2| ≤ √x/20 + 3 under RiemannHypothesis.
gaps.needs: Bach's explicit bounds for the smoothed Chebyshev sums Σ_{n<x} Λ(n)χ(n)(1 − n/x) under DirichletGRH χ for χ non-principal modulo a prime, and for the principal sum under RiemannHypothesis

gaps.title: Nonnegative trigonometric polynomials as Props
gaps.detail: Kadiri's degree-four and Mossinghoff–Trudgian's degree-sixteen polynomials with literal coefficients.
gaps.needs: the Props asserting nonnegativity of the two polynomials

gaps.title: The Burgess moment estimate
gaps.detail: Σ_x |Σ_{m<h} χ(x+m)|^{2r} ≤ ((2r)!/(2^r r!)) p h^r + (2r−1)√p h^{2r} and the r = 2 refinements.
gaps.needs: the explicit 2r-th moment of short character sums over 𝔽_p

gaps.title: Lapkova's Pólya–Vinogradov form
gaps.detail: For every primitive χ modulo q ≥ q₀ > 1, even or odd, and every M: |Σ_{n≤M} χ(n)| ≤ A(q₀)√q log q with A(q₀) = 1/(2π) + 0.8204/√q₀ + 1.0285/(√q₀ log q₀) (kerrmcgowntrudgian2020 Lemma 3).
gaps.needs: the Pólya–Vinogradov bound |Σ_{n≤M} χ(n)| ≤ A(q₀)√q log q for every primitive character χ modulo q ≥ q₀ > 1, even or odd (so for every non-principal character modulo a prime)

gaps.title: Piltz divisor sums
gaps.detail: Bordellès' three bounds for Σ_{m≤x} τ_k(m) and the quartic bound (1/3) x log³ x for x ≥ 193.
gaps.needs: the explicit Piltz divisor-sum bounds and the quartic asymptotic

gaps.title: Robin's bound for ω
gaps.detail: ω(m) ≤ 1.3841 log m/log log m for m ≥ 3.
gaps.needs: the explicit pointwise bound for the number of distinct prime factors

gaps.title: The Rosser–Schoenfeld totient bound
gaps.detail: m/φ(m) ≤ e^γ log log m + 2.51/log log m for m ≥ 3 (Rosser–Schoenfeld 1962, Theorem 15).
gaps.needs: the Rosser–Schoenfeld bound m/φ(m) ≤ e^γ log log m + 2.51/log log m for every m ≥ 3

gaps.title: Schoenfeld's second Mertens theorem under RH
gaps.detail: Under RiemannHypothesis, for x ≥ 13.5: |Σ_{p≤x} 1/p − log log x − M| < (3 log x + 4)/(8π√x), M = mertensConstant ℚ (Schoenfeld 1976, Corollary 2, (6.21)).
gaps.needs: Schoenfeld's two-sided bound |Σ_{p≤x} 1/p − log log x − M| < (3 log x + 4)/(8π√x) for x ≥ 13.5 under RiemannHypothesis, with M the Meissel–Mertens constant

gaps.title: Norm compatibility of the global Artin map
gaps.detail: For H/F abelian and K/F finite, the Artin symbol for HK/K restricted to H is the Artin symbol of the norm for H/F.
gaps.needs: the ideal-theoretic norm functoriality of the global Artin map under a change of base field: the Artin symbol of 𝔞 for HK/K restricts on H to the Artin symbol of N_{K/F} 𝔞 for H/F
